svg.title: Marginal densities of three order statistics from ten uniform draws
svg.desc: Three density curves on the interval from zero to one. The smallest of ten draws piles up against zero, the fifth smallest is a broad hump centred near 0.45, and the largest piles up against one.
svg.text: value y, for draws uniform on the interval 0 to 1
Sorting ten draws produces ten different distributions
Triangles on the baseline mark the three means, at 1/11, 5/11 and 10/11. The two extremes
crowd the endpoints and the middle one is broad, so no single shape describes them all. Each
curve is a Beta density: X(k) from n uniform draws follows Beta(k, n - k + 1).
